Ask the assistant about the signed-in user's tracked products (their
searches of the last 90 days): prices, seasons (Hot Sale, Buen Fin) and
uncertain matches. Runs within the plan's daily token budget.

429.description: `agent_budget` (daily tokens used up) or plan rate limit

Propose a verdict on a `needs_review` match in the user's recent
searches. Stores a suggestion only; the user confirms it in the app.

Stores the user's store memberships and completes onboarding. Offers
that need a membership the user lacks are hidden from search results.

Daily low/high price per matched retailer listing, for the product
chart. Listings needing a membership the user lacks are left out and
counted.

needing a membership the user lacks are left out and counted.

calculation as search results.

offer.description: The offer, with this tenant's match decisions applied.

hidden.description: Offers hidden because they need a membership the user lacks.

AgentPriceHistoryResponse.description: Price stats and daily history of a product.

history.description: Daily low/high per listing over the requested days.

stats.description: 30/90/365-day low, high and average per listing.

asin.description: Amazon product of the match under review.

AgentUsageRequest.description: Body of `POST /internal/agent/usage`: tokens of one finished turn.

remaining_tokens.description: Tokens the tenant may still use today (0 when spent).

ChatRequest.description: Body of `POST /assistant/chat`: the whole conversation, oldest first.

messages.description:
1–20 messages, at most 16 000 characters in total, the last from
the user.

reply.description: Answer text (plain text; render it escaped).

suggestions.description: Match suggestions made during this run.

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` on every non-GET request.

DailyPriceResponse.description: One UTC day of a listing's prices.

day_ms.description: Start of the UTC day (epoch milliseconds).

high_centavos.description: Highest price seen that day, in centavos.

in_stock.description: Whether any observation that day was in stock.

low_centavos.description: Lowest price seen that day, in centavos.

ErrorResponse.description: Error body: a fixed, machine-readable code (the web app translates it).

status.description: Always `"ok"` when the process is serving requests.

ListingPriceSeriesResponse.description: Daily prices for one retailer listing matched to the product.

ListingPriceStatsResponse.description: Price windows for one retailer listing matched to the product.

asin.description: Amazon product of the match under review.

suggestion_id.description: The assistant suggestion being confirmed, if any.

MatchSuggestionResponse.description:
A verdict the assistant proposed; nothing changes until the user
confirms it with `POST /matches/decisions`.

asin.description: Amazon product of the match under review.

id.description: Suggestion id (pass it as `suggestion_id` when confirming).

reason.description: Why, in the assistant's words (untrusted text).

title.description: Listing title (from the user's own search results).

MeResponse.description: The account as shown to its owner.

PriceHistoryResponse.description: Daily price series for an Amazon product across matched listings.

hidden_listings.description:
Listings left out because they need a store membership (Costco,
Sam's Club) the user lacks.

listings.description:
One entry per accepted listing the user may see, sorted by retailer
then SKU.

title.description:
Amazon product name, when the worker has stored one (absent for
products matched before names were kept).

PriceStatsResponse.description: Price stats for an Amazon product across matched retailer listings.

as_of_ms.description: Instant every window ends at (epoch milliseconds).

hidden_listings.description:
Listings left out because they need a store membership (Costco,
Sam's Club) the user lacks.

listings.description:
One entry per accepted listing the user may see, sorted by retailer
then SKU.

title.description:
Amazon product name, when the worker has stored one (absent for
products matched before names were kept).

PriceWindowResponse.description:
Low, high and average price over one window. Amounts are integer
centavos; they are absent when no in-stock price was observed.

average_centavos.description: Mean price (rounded half up), in centavos.

observations.description: Observations counted (out-of-stock prices are not counted).

RetailerAccessCounts.description: Access outcomes for one retailer host.

retailer.description: Retailer id from the registry, or the host when it is not registered.

skipped_robots.description: URLs skipped because robots.txt disallows them.

RoiItemRequest.description: One item to evaluate. Amounts are integer centavos (0 or more).

amazon_fees_centavos.description: Amazon fees for one unit at the selling price.

units_per_month.description: Units sold per month (needed when monthly fixed costs are set).

RoiItemResponse.description:
Result for one item, in input order. Money is centavos, ratios basis
points. `error` is set (and the numbers absent) when the item cannot be
computed.

fixed_cost_per_unit_centavos.description: Share of the monthly fixed costs per unit.

profit_centavos.description: Profit per unit (negative for a loss).

results.description: One result per item, in input order.

SearchMatchResponse.description:
Amazon match and ROI for one result. Money is integer centavos and
ratios are basis points.

amazon_price_centavos.description: Amazon selling price used (buy box, else lowest new), in centavos.

fees_centavos.description: Estimated Amazon fees at that price, in centavos.

margin_bp.description: Profit over selling price, basis points.

profit_centavos.description: Profit per unit, in centavos (negative for a loss).

roi_bp.description: Profit over total cost, basis points.

SearchResponse.description: A search with its status, per-retailer outcomes and results.

created_at_ms.description: When the search was created (epoch milliseconds).

hidden_results.description: Results hidden because they need a store membership the user lacks.

results.description: Results, sorted by retailer then SKU.

SearchResultResponse.description: One retailer offer found by a search.

oneOf.description: Amazon match and ROI, when one was found.

availability.description: `in_stock`, `out_of_stock` or `unknown` when the offer was seen.

membership_required.description: Buying needs a store membership (Costco, Sam's Club) the user holds.

SearchRetailerResponse.description: What one retailer contributed to a search.

outcome.description:
`ok`, `category_only` (no keyword search; covered by scheduled
category browsing), `blocked_needs_kyc`, `skipped_robots`, `failed`
or `no_offers`.

SessionResponse.description: A new session: the account and its fresh CSRF token.

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` on every non-GET request.

query.description: Keywords, 1–100 characters after trimming and collapsing spaces.
